query:
SELECT 
  r.firstName,
  r.lastName,
  p.packageType,
  p.totalHours,
  p.usedHours,
  p.endDate,
  p.reminderSent,
  p.expirationEmailSent
FROM residents r
JOIN packages p ON r.id = p.residentId
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND p.status = 'active';
